correctness.rationale: The alternating-pair embedding bounds universality at m, and the pair-merging lemma reduces length-(m+1) absent candidates to monotone strings. Gap prefix-sum criteria leave exactly 1, 2, or 3 candidates, with root partition (t,2t,2(m-t)). The Fibonacci morphism preserves the three forbidden cyclic factors. Independently enumerated all 72 admissible ordered gap tuples and 1,122 roots for 2<=m<=7; literal subsequence membership reproduced the entire predicted absent sets for every tested root. The restricted-cycle inductive proof, not the finite test, establishes all m.
residual_risks: All-length proof is mathematical, not established by bounded test.
